title: The Geometry of Forgetting: Temporal Knowledge Drift as an Independent Axis in LLM Representations
authors: Rania Elbadry; Ahmed Heakl; Fan Zhang; Dani Bouch; Yuxia Wang; Preslav Nakov; Zhuohan Xie
why_relevant: Studies internal detection of temporally stale parametric knowledge, which relates to knowing when to retrieve (selective retrieval trigger) and uncertainty about parametric vs external knowledge.
